definitions.explanation: To ease someone's grief or distress.

examples.japanese: {悲|かな}しんでいる{友達|ともだち}を{慰|なぐさ}める。
{自分|じぶん}を{慰|なぐさ}める。
{試合|しあい}に{負|ま}けて{泣|な}いている{子供|こども}を{優|やさ}しく{慰|なぐさ}めた。
examples.english: I gently comforted the child who was crying after losing the game.

notes:
{慰|なぐさ}める means to comfort or console someone who is sad or distressed.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {慰|なぐさ}む (intransitive, to find comfort)

ASPECT (ている):
{慰|なぐさ}めている indicates the ongoing act of comforting someone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {友達|ともだち}を{慰|なぐさ}める: to comfort a friend
- {悲|かな}しんでいる{人|ひと}を{慰|なぐさ}める: to console someone who is grieving
- {自分|じぶん}を{慰|なぐさ}める: to console oneself
- {言葉|ことば}で{慰|なぐさ}める: to comfort with words

RELATED WORDS:
- {慰|なぐさ}め: comfort, consolation (noun)
- {慰安|いあん}: comfort, solace
- {慰謝料|いしゃりょう}: consolation money, damages
- {慰労|いろう}: recognition of someone's hard work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {励|はげ}ます: to encourage (focuses on cheering up)
- {慰|なぐさ}める: to comfort (focuses on easing sorrow)
